title: 2008 AMC 10A Problem 1
statement: A bakery owner turns on his doughnut machine at \(8{:}30\) am. At \(11{:}10\) am the machine has completed one third of the day’s job. At what time will the doughnut machine complete the job?

solutions.text:
From \(8{:}30\) am to \(11{:}10\) am is \(2\) hours and \(40\) minutes, or \(160\) minutes, to finish one third of the job.

The entire job therefore takes \(3 \cdot 160 = 480\) minutes, or \(8\) hours.

Eight hours after \(8{:}30\) am is \(4{:}30\) pm.

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: Find how long one third of the job takes, in minutes
The whole job takes three times as long, measured from the \(8{:}30\) am start
